pages.text: $(bold)Arcane Domination$() (comes with Magic Gold, $(bold)no levels$())$(br2)Effect: $(bold)all schools gain +100% spell power$() (while held or worn)$(br2)Note: Iron's Spells' generic spell power attribute defaults to 1.0 and already applies to every school, so +1.0 means double power across the board.$(br2)$(italic)Not borrowed power - commanded.$()
